profile.headline: Data Security SWE @Google
profile.summary: Software engineering leader with 9+ years of experience building high-performing engineering teams and architecting reliable web and distributed systems. Blends a track record of people leadership and 0-to-1 startup execution (Engineering Manager & Employee #15 at Moov Financial) with large-scale distributed systems and developer tooling at Google. Deep technical foundation across React, TypeScript, Node.js, Java, and cloud data platforms. Skilled at unblocking complex technical bottlenecks, partnering directly with cross-functional stakeholders, and fostering engineering cultures centered on velocity, technical rigor, and autonomy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer Velocity & Platform Modernization: Led an engineering productivity initiative across 4 core codebases, migrating 59 packages and 280+ legacy web test targets to modern test frameworks. Cut total suite runtimes by 68.2%, eliminated chronic deployment blockers, and engineered AI agent skills to automate ongoing migrations.

Complex Full-Stack Architecture: Architected and deployed end-to-end full-stack features enabling secure data access and real-time auditing for autonomous enterprise AI agents.

Technical Leadership Under Ambiguity: Steered rapid technical resolution for critical production bottlenecks and incomplete feature specs, including external guest account policies, and async queue blockages.

Cross-Functional Bridge: Served as primary technical point of contact aligning UX, Product Management, and Engineering to expedite critical bug fixes and binary releases, mitigating high-risk customer churn.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Joined as 15th hire in the company. I was promoted from Senior eng, to team lead, to eng manager.

People Management & Scaling: Managed cross-functional frontend and backend engineering teams through high-growth seed and Series A stages. Structured code review standards, and technical hiring criteria.

0-to-1 Architecture & Execution: Partnered directly with founders, product leads, and compliance teams to design and ship modern administrative applications and fintech infrastructure from scratch using React, TypeScript, and modern APIs.

Developer Experience & Tooling: Spearheaded frontend architectural standards across payment products, establishing reusable component libraries and type-safe workflows that accelerated feature turnaround.

Mentorship & Culture: Mentored engineers across experience levels, cultivating an engineering culture anchored in high autonomy, psychological safety, and continuous delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · CSS · TypeScript · React.js · Management

positions.title: Software Developer III, VP
positions.description: Frontend development (Angular8) on a new commercial web portal built on the Backbase platform.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · CSS · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Amazon Connect development and implementation for various clients.

Develop Connect contact flows, Lex bots, lambda functions, and web applications for enterprise contact center solutions.

VoiceFoundry specializes in the delivery of Amazon Connect cloud-based enterprise contact center solutions around the globe and are uniquely focused on helping businesses improve customer engagement, while maximizing the benefits of the cloud.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · CSS · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js

positions.title: Senior Web Programmer
positions.description:
Led full-stack technical execution for custom web applications and e-commerce platforms, taking client initiatives end-to-end from initial architecture to production deployment.

Managed client-facing technical discussions, scoping requirements, and translating ambiguous project goals into performant, modern web solutions.

positions.title: Inventory Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for stainless tubing inventory management.

Developed material stocking strategies for stainless tubing, and created an audit system to ensure that all materials were compliant with their strategy specifications. 

Lead weekly inventory management meetings, identified issues, and delegated tasks. Lead efforts that resulted in a 14% reduction in aged inventory, and hit monthly inventory turns targets for 5 consecutive months.

positions.title: Project Manager/Business Development Manager
positions.description:
•	Received Core Value Award for leading North America wide, interdepartmental team in a project to design and implement a new order processing and tracking solution.
•	Resolved customer issues by communicating requirements to internal teams and managing projects to completion.
•	Created inventory management tools that instantly pull, scrub, and analyze data used by the sales team to proactively sell slow moving stock. This increased inventory turnover and lowered inventory holding costs.

positions.title: Assembly Maintenance & Overhaul Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Served as internal process improvement consultant to North American Operations, and earned several Core Value Awards for providing quick results and exceeding expectations.
•	Redesigned SharePoint based solution used to create orders and track through quote, assembly, shipping, and billing. This system provides real time updates on order status and revenue estimates.
•	Supervised team of 17 across 3 departments. Conducted performance reviews, provided coaching, and managed HR related matters.
•	Designed SharePoint-based assembly tracking tools that improved efficiency and shop activity visibility.

positions.title: Sales & Operations Demand Planner
positions.description:
•	Worked with global team to create world-wide product sales forecast and material replenishment planning.
•	Presented global forecast analysis to key business leaders at monthly Sales & Operations Planning meetings.

positions.title: Lead Pricing Analyst
positions.description:
•	Identified price increase opportunities leading to a projected $3 million per year revenue increase.
•	Optimized fuel compliance reporting process via Excel VB macros, eliminating approximately 260 hours per year.

positions.title: Contracts Specialist
positions.description: •	Developed best practice sale, lease, and preferred provider agreement contract templates that reduced both response time, and contract errors.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
•	Performed Kaizen event at airport location which increased speed of the turn back process and reduced holding time and associated costs of grounded vehicles on location.
•	Developed Six Sigma project dashboards to monitor project performance.

positions.title: Revenue Management Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Made improvements to analysis tools in MS Excel that saved approximately 400 hours per year for Revenue Management department.
•	Received the Balanced Growth Award for leading the Revenue Management team in revenue per utilization for 5 consecutive weeks.
